physicalNotes: Radius 1.06 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Serrano Bell et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1273 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A...6S/abstract): 737,442 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.06 +/- 0.06 solar masses from Serrano Bell et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1273 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A...6S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5690 +/- 40 K from Serrano Bell et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1273 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A...6S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
